title: Covariance-Aware Transformers for Quadratic Programming and Decision Making
abstract: arXiv:2602.14506v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We explore the use of transformers for solving quadratic programs and how this capability benefits decision-making problems that involve covariance matrices. We first show that the linear attention mechanism can provably solve unconstrained QPs by tokenizing the matrix variables (e.g.~$A$ of the objective $\frac{1}{2}x^\top Ax+b^\top x$) row-by-row and emulating gradient descent iterations. Furthermore, by incorporating MLPs, a transformer block can solve (i) $\ell_1$-penalized QPs by emulating iterative soft-thresholding and (ii) $\ell_1$-constrained QPs when equipped with an additional feedback loop. Our theory motivates us to introduce Time2Decide: a generic method that enhances a time series foundation model (TSFM) by explicitly feeding the covariance matrix between the variates. translated_title: 协方差感知的Transformer用于二次规划与决策制定
translated_abstract: 我们探索了使用Transformer求解二次规划问题，以及这种能力如何有益于涉及协方差矩阵的决策问题。我们首先证明，线性注意力机制可以通过逐行对矩阵变量（例如目标函数½x^T Ax + b^T x中的A）进行分词（tokenize）并模拟梯度下降迭代，从而可证明地求解无约束二次规划（QP）。此外，通过结合MLP，一个Transformer块可以求解：(i) ℓ1惩罚的QP（通过模拟迭代软阈值算法）；以及(ii) 在配备额外反馈回路的情况下求解ℓ1约束的QP。我们的理论启发我们提出Time2Decide：一种通用方法，通过显式输入变量之间的协方差矩阵来增强时间序列基础模型（TSFM）。我们通过实验发现，对于经典的带有ℓ1约束的投资组合优化问题，Time2Decide在所有情况下都一致优于基础TSFM模型。
tldr: 本文从理论上证明Transformer可通过模拟梯度下降和软阈值迭代来求解无约束及ℓ1惩罚/约束的二次规划，并据此提出Time2Decide方法，通过向时间序列基础模型显式输入变量间协方差矩阵，显著提升投资组合优化等决策任务的表现。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that transformers can provably solve unconstrained and ℓ1-penalized/constrained quadratic programs by emulating gradient descent and soft-thresholding iterations, and introduces Time2Decide, a method that enhances time series foundation models by explicitly feeding covariance matrices, uniformly improving performance on portfolio optimization tasks.
